title: Agent 2.0 — Faster, Higher Quality, Lower Price

sections.label: Agent 2.0
items: New agent core — faster turnaround on every build and update
Higher build quality across all tiers with smarter planning and fewer wasted iterations
Lower cost per build — same quality, less spend
Added voice to text function for making prompts

sections.label: Style Picker
items: Pick your app's look before the build: style, theme, header, density, bottom menu — each with a live preview
9 new visual styles added: Nature, Corporate, Paper, Aurora, Brutalist, Liquid, Titanium, Signal, Holo
4 new bottom-menu layouts: Flat Tab Bar, Floating Pill, Liquid Glass, Flat + Center FAB
"Auto" option per category — let the AI choose what fits your idea best
Full localization for the picker (EN / RU / UA)

sections.label: Bug Fixes
items: Progress bar no longer freezes at 0% for the first 20–30s on devices with skewed clocks
Insufficient-balance message is now compact and red for returning depositors (the big onboarding card stays for first-timers)

sections.label: Reliability & Errors
items: Update process now catches AI errors and shows a friendly stop message instead of getting stuck
Stuck progress card is automatically removed when an error occurs, so you can continue right away
Fixed bug where deposits weren't being credited to balance
Fixed bot commands not responding after build

sections.label: Bot & App Quality
items: AI now configures bot commands menu (setMyCommands) on every new app for a polished UX
New "Bot Management" skill — AI knows the right way to wire commands, /start deep links, callbacks and webhooks for 100% reliability
Confirmation dialog before purchasing a paid Feature — no more accidental charges
Upgraded model to Opus 4.7 for higher build quality on Best & The Best tiers

sections.label: Authentication & Security
items: Web launch /start — open the Mini App from a browser via Telegram Login
Added account-stealing protection: stricter init-data validation everywhere

sections.label: Growth & Analytics
items: Telegram Mini Apps Analytics integrated for proper funnel tracking
Retention pushes — users who haven't finished onboarding receive 3 smart reminders (registered → bot created → plan ready), each fires once per user, fully localized
Partner referral links now point directly to the Mini App with /start attribution preserved

sections.label: apps-father.com
items: Launched the official website at apps-father.com — fully translated EN/RU with auto language detection
Mobile-optimized landing nav with a single Start button
All site CTAs forward the ?startapp source tag into Telegram for accurate attribution
Google Ads conversion tracking on every Telegram CTA click

sections.label: Payments & Balance
items: TON deposits — top up directly with TON
CryptoBot opens instantly inside Telegram instead of browser
Other Crypto payment method fixed on mobile

sections.label: AI & Chat
items: Ask mode now tracks full dialog history for better context
Ask mode cost multiplier applied correctly
Agent iterations limit raised from 60 to 100 for all tiers
Ctrl+V to paste images directly into chat

sections.label: App Dashboard
items: Web App URL visible in App Dashboard
Process blur effect when input is disabled
App error overlay shown only to the owner
Abort button to stop a running process mid-way

sections.label: Partnership Program
items: Partners get a personal dashboard: referred users, revenue, commission
Admins can assign partner status and set referral percentage per user
Partners can withdraw or transfer earnings from their partner balance
Referral system improvements

sections.label: UI & UX
items: Scroll fixed in multiple views
Notification message when process finishes — with View Details button
Text selection enabled in chat messages
Localization fixes across the platform
Admin-only controls (Update Context, Download Log, See Agent Log) hidden for regular users
New app slot price reduced to $5

sections.label: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed double process message on first plan confirmation
Fixed log viewer loading old entries
Removed non-functional Answer messages from chat
Admin Panel feature hidden from paid features list

sections.label: Chat & Interaction
items: Agent questions with selectable options and custom input
AI-powered update suggestions
Ask mode with streaming responses and haptic feedback
Chat input disabled during processing
Empty chat welcome screen with animation
Skeleton loading for chat history

sections.label: App Management
items: New app creation flow with slot system
Plan generation with "Let's Build" and "Edit" actions
Instant build start with progress feedback
Release updates directly from chat
Version changelog on Telegraph
Friendly error for small avatar uploads

sections.label: Payments & Balance
items: Top Up page with Crypto Bot, USDT, and Stars
Insufficient balance card with quick top-up action
Live cost tracking during updates

sections.label: UI & UX
items: Custom toast notification system
Haptic feedback on all interactions
Chat header dropdown with quick actions
Mode selector with icons
Mobile-optimized scroll and safe areas
Samples showcase section

Context compacting for faster updates
Reduced pricing across all tiers
Improved parallel builds
Image vision for design references
Summarizing step visible in progress flow
